policy: Native Go migration of five behavioral contracts; legal API inputs and explicit injected dependencies. The unchanged original pytest corpus and failures remain a separate historical run.

cases.assertion_intent: A caller-pinned two-shot contract outranks a director asking for three shots. Wrong-count artifacts must fail validation.
cases.adaptation: Use a valid text-only Go request for an asset-free scene. Preserve conflicting director words and the two-shot pin through public Compile into the actual writer request. Correct two-shot artifacts succeed; structural or writer candidates following the director's three-shot request fail without publishing an artifact.

cases.assertion_intent: Every media label used in a native H3 prompt has the matching real input binding in its manifest; supplied reference bindings are nonempty. Phantom references fail.
cases.adaptation: Keep the original ref1.png and request, with explicitly injected archived observed fields. Verify final prompt label-set equality with the nonempty manifest and independently rebuild it from the actual Document; retain the text-only empty case and phantom-label rejection. No caller note is promoted to observation.

cases.assertion_intent: An actual first-frame anchor licenses its observed pose; an ordinary identity reference does not. Rendering preserves this distinction.
cases.adaptation: Select OfficialProfile for the published IR/prompt contract. Verify Draft and public Compile final subject definitions, observed identity, authorized pose and zero-time anchor. The same observation as an ordinary subject compiles with identity but no published pose/anchor, while evidence retains its pose. Unsupported ComfyUI exact-reference anchors are tested separately.

cases.assertion_intent: A requested medium/style change does not change an image or frame anchor retention relationship into attribute_transfer.
cases.adaptation: Test valid subject/ref2va, first-frame/i2va, last-frame/l2va and two-image fl2va inputs. Preserve observed sources and transformation intent; source/target style controls retain identical markers, both FL2VA endpoint anchors and manifest target uses. Reject partially preserved or transferred frame candidates; retain missing FL2VA-image rejection separately.

cases.assertion_intent: A specific cel-animation transformation remains represented even within the same 2D bucket; unknown classifications do not invent a comparison, while a known cross-bucket regression is detected.
cases.adaptation: Allow the typed Go semantic boundary to classify cel animation as 2d-animation instead of reproducing the old lexical classifier None. Assert transformation/style preservation and correct regression-check behavior, including an explicit unknown branch.
